sentences.zh: 那么给我们讲讲，我的意思是，我们已经听过一些关于Akasa的故事，你们在做什么，以及你们是如何做的。

sentences.en: That's, that's, that's, that's applause worthy.
sentences.zh: 你们主要是办公室办公吗？

sentences.en: Awesome.
sentences.zh: 你们在做远程办公吗？

sentences.en: So tell us a bit about, I mean, we kind of heard a bit of the story of Akasa and what you guys are doing and how you're doing it.
sentences.zh: 你们在招聘吗？

sentences.en: Are you guys like, for are you mostly in office?
sentences.zh: Akasa现在的状况如何？

sentences.en: Are you doing a little bit of remote work?
sentences.zh: 是的，当然。

sentences.en: Are you guys hiring?
sentences.zh: Akasa发展得非常好，增长非常快。我想我们现在有大约250名全职员工，我加入公司快三年了。

sentences.en: Like, what's kind of the state of Akasa these days?
sentences.zh: 所以2019年10月，我想那时我们大约只有五到十个人。

sentences.en: Yeah, absolutely.
sentences.zh: 所以这是一个巨大的增长。

sentences.en: Akasa is doing really well and growing very faSt. So I think we're up to about 250 full-time employees now, which I joined the company almost three years ago.
sentences.zh: 公司完全支持远程办公。

sentences.en: So October 2019, I think we were about five or 10 people back then.
sentences.zh: 所以，我想凭借你寻找软件工程师的地方，很多软件工程师仍然住在湾区。

sentences.en: So it's been tremendous growth.
sentences.zh: 但是，在我的团队中，我们有来自全国各地的人，我们现在是一家远程公司。

sentences.en: Company is fully remote friendly.
sentences.zh: 我们绝对在招聘各种工程和产品职位。

sentences.en: So, you know, I'd say by virtue of where you find software engineers, a lot of software engineers still happen to live in the Bay Area.
sentences.zh: 具体来说，我们现在正在招聘全栈工程师，以及数据工程师和前端工程师。

sentences.en: But, you know, on my team, we have people all over the country and we're, we're, we're a remote company at this point.
sentences.zh: 所以基本上是在全面招聘。

sentences.en: And absolutely we're hiring for all sorts of engineering and product roles.
sentences.zh: 不错。

sentences.en: So specifically, you know, right now we're hiring full stack engineers as well as data engineers and, and front end engineers.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: So hiring across the board basically.
sentences.zh: 我们会在节目说明中提供职业页面的链接。

sentences.en: Nice.
sentences.zh: 去看看吧。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 你们有暑期实习生吗？

sentences.en: And we'll have the link in the show notes to, to the career page.
sentences.zh: 有的。

sentences.en: I mean, go check it out.
sentences.zh: 我们做过一些机器学习实习，也做过几个软件工程实习。

sentences.en: And do you guys do, do internships for, for summer interns?
sentences.zh: 不错。

sentences.en: We do.
sentences.zh: 我认为在初创公司实习可能比在大公司实习更有趣。

sentences.en: We've done some machine learning internships and we've also done a couple of software engineering internships.
sentences.zh: 是的，确实如此。

sentences.en: Nice.
sentences.zh: 非常感谢你今天能来。

sentences.en: I think an internship at a startup might be particularly interesting rather than a startup at a big company.
sentences.zh: 非常感谢邀请我。

sentences.en: I feel like there's like a big compare and contrast there, but I feel like that could be really interesting.
sentences.zh: 我觉得这之间有很大的对比，但我觉得这可能会非常有趣。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: I will say when I was in college, I, I interned at two startups and I found it to be a really interesting experience because first of all, the stuff you build actually gets used
sentences.zh: 我得说，我在大学时曾在两家初创公司实习过，我发现那是一段非常有意思的经历，因为首先，你构建的东西真的会被投入使用，

sentences.en: in production just because, you know, a lot of startups are started for resources.
sentences.zh: 直接用于生产环境，因为你知道，很多初创公司都缺乏资源。

sentences.en: And so if they have someone, they'll put you on something that's useful and that they really need to get done, which I thought was pretty cool.
sentences.zh: 所以如果他们有人手，就会让你去做一些真正有用且他们急需完成的工作，我觉得这很酷。

sentences.en: And also you just, you get to see the inner workings of the company a little bit more when it's smaller, you get to see how things work and, you know, how projects get planned.
sentences.zh: 而且在规模较小的公司，你能更多地看到公司的内部运作，了解事情是如何开展的，以及项目是如何规划的。

sentences.en: Whereas probably at a bigger company, you'll, you'll learn a ton as well and work on great technology.
sentences.zh: 而在大公司，你可能也能学到很多东西，并接触到很棒的技术。

sentences.en: But a lot of that, you know, vision or design is already done for you before you, before you come in.
sentences.zh: 但很多愿景或设计在你加入之前就已经定好了。

sentences.en: Yeah, that was well said.
sentences.zh: 没错，说得好。

sentences.en: All right.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: Well, awesome.
sentences.zh: 太棒了。

sentences.en: Thank you so much for, for joining the show today, Sanjay.
sentences.zh: 非常感谢你今天参加我们的节目，Sanjay。

sentences.en: I think this is a great, like we, we interweaved the, the kind of narratives together, but I feel it was a great exploration of, of kind of this space and the domain and the,
sentences.zh: 我觉得这很棒，我们把各种叙述交织在了一起，我觉得这是一次对这个领域和范畴的深入探讨，

sentences.en: the sort of this balance between general purpose solutions and like specific things.
sentences.zh: 以及关于通用解决方案和特定事物之间平衡的探讨。

sentences.en: I, I really enjoyed our conversation today.
sentences.zh: 我非常享受我们今天的谈话。

sentences.en: Thank you so much for coming on the show.
sentences.zh: 非常感谢你来到我们的节目。

sentences.en: Thank you so much for having me.

sentences.en: All right.
